entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: It seems you've got your share of[n]problems, Inmate.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: To think you would relax under such[n]circumstances. Either you're quite bold...[n]or quite foolish.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: It seems you've been targeted by[n]troublesome company.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: *chuckle* I've been enjoying this endless[n]dispute over "justice."

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: However, it will soon come to an end—[n]and through the appearance of an[n]unexpected force, of all things.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: Engaging with formidable enemies is[n]also part of your rehabilitation. I ask that[n]you overcome this.

entries.speaker: Igor
entries.en: After all, you must hone your powers...[n]and become a magnificent thief...
